description: This Java class defines a custom exception 'GLAccountInvalidParentException' used in the accounting module of the Fineract project. It extends a base exception class and is thrown when an invalid parent account is assigned to a general ledger (GL) account.

classes.name: GLAccountInvalidParentException
classes.description: A runtime exception indicating an invalid parent account assignment in the GL accounting context.

methods.name: GLAccountInvalidParentException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific error message involving the account ID.
